name: Field
label: Field
description: The shared scaffolding for labelled form controls: label, required marker, helper and error text, and the ARIA wiring that ties them together.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text rendered above the control

props.name: children
props.description: The form control this field labels

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text rendered below the control. With `errorText` it stays as it is while an error shows; with the older `error` flag it is recoloured as the error message.

props.name: errorText
props.description:
The error message, shown under the control in the error colour while the
helper text keeps its place, and announced politely when it changes.
Setting it marks the field invalid, so `error` is not needed alongside
it. The older form, `error` with the message in `helperText`, still
works.

props.name: aside
props.description:
Optional content rendered opposite the helper text — a character counter,
a unit, a "0/280". Present only when supplied; without it the helper sits
directly in the field's column and no extra wrapper is introduced.

props.name: error
props.description: Error state: marks the control invalid and, in the older form without `errorText`, recolours the helper text as the error message.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and renders the required marker

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the control is disabled — dims the label

props.name: group
props.description:
Group mode: renders the label as a `<span id>` instead of a
`<label htmlFor>`, for scaffolding a set of controls (a checkbox or
radio group) where no single labelable element exists — the group node
points `aria-labelledby` at the span via `labelId`.

props.name: id
props.description:
id for the control. Generated when omitted, so the label/control/helper
association works with no configuration.
